recordedBy: the session that made this evidence, reading an installed FedWiki (wiki-client and wiki-server); the installation's location is not recorded
reRead: to check these lines again, bind *FEDWIKI-NODE-MODULES* or set HYPERDOC_FEDWIKI_NODE_MODULES to the node_modules directory of that FedWiki installation

sources.role: The FedWiki client dates an Action before it is stored
The FedWiki server appends the Action it receives to the journal as it is
The FedWiki server takes a page's last edit date from journal entries that have a date
